name: Sewer Run 2: Nite Ops
summary: Pick your player, choose your board, and get ready once again to ride the wildest open sewer runs -- this time under the cover of darkness. Ride over ramps, rails, through tunnels and dangling pipes to reach the final jump and parachute down to the finish platform. Blast and battle your way past up to seven opponents, ride the slalom runs and pull off some funky freestyle moves on your way to more mountainboarding fame.
